description: A fictional stubby heavy scatter pistol game prop for a tunnel breaker, chunky low-poly, one hand, held level with the muzzle forward. One short thick brick red-brown painted slide block with wide chamfers and one long raised flat rib along the middle of its top. At the rear of the top two thick raised charcoal sight blocks side by side. Under the front of the frame one fat round brick red-brown drum magazine about 0.11 m across, a faceted short cylinder whose axis runs left to right, its flat faces on the flanks, each flat face with one big octagonal dark steel hub cap, held by one fat charcoal latch block above it. Behind the drum one squared charcoal trigger guard with a thick charcoal trigger. At the rear one chunky charcoal pistol grip raked back with four fat diagonal ribs and a fat flared base. One small rectangular teal lamp window in a thick raised charcoal bezel on the left flank of the slide at its rear.
proportions: At the front one wide flat dark steel duckbill muzzle, a flat rectangular tube about 0.09 m wide and 0.03 m tall with a thick chamfered rim and a dark inside that closes a short way in. About 0.30 m long, 0.12 m wide and 0.24 m tall. (length : width : height = 3.33 : 1 : 0.33)
sides: only the teal lamp window is on one flank: on the LEFT flank of the slide at its rear; the right flank of the slide is plain red-brown. The drum is symmetric: both its flat faces (left and right flank) carry one big octagonal hub cap; the drum is wider than the slide and sticks out on both sides equally. The slide, its top rib, the two rear sight blocks (side by side, mirrored), the muzzle, the latch block, the trigger guard and the grip are on the centre line.
